name: BTC Short on Rising Yields & VIX
description:
**Macro-driven BTC short strategy** that enters short positions when:

1. **US 10-Year Treasury yield** rises 3 consecutive days (yield_t > yield_{t-1} > yield_{t-2} > yield_{t-3})
2. **VIX is rising** (VIX_t > VIX_{t-1})
3. **VIX level > 18** (elevated volatility regime)

**Key Design**: Uses sequential non-null row ordering to detect consecutive yield rises, accounting for the fact that crypto trades weekends but Treasury/VIX data doesn't publish on weekends.

**Risk Management**: 2% portfolio risk per trade with 0.50% take profit and 1.00% stop loss, plus 2-bar time exit.
source:
# BTC Short on Rising Yields & VIX
# Short BTC when macro risk signals align:
# - 3 consecutive daily rises in US 10-Year Treasury yield
# - VIX rising and above 18 (elevated volatility regime)

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# =============================================================================

# Primary asset: BTC/USD
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# US 10-Year Treasury Yield from FRED (DGS10)
# use_alfred=False for daily market data (indexed by observation date)
treasury_obs_date, treasury_10y_raw, treasury_rev = economic_indicators(series_id="DGS10", use_alfred=False)()

# VIX from FRED (VIXCLS)
vix_obs_date, vix_raw, vix_rev = economic_indicators(series_id="VIXCLS", use_alfred=False)()

# Forward-fill both indicators to align with daily crypto bars
treasury_10y = ffill(treasury_10y_raw)
vix = ffill(vix_raw)

# =============================================================================
# SEQUENTIAL VALID-ROW DETECTION
# =============================================================================
# Crypto trades weekends, but Treasury/VIX don't publish on weekends.
# Detect consecutive rises using only rows where data actually updated.

# Identify rows where BOTH indicators have valid (non-null) raw values
# This marks days where Treasury and VIX actually published new data
treasury_valid = is_valid(treasury_10y_raw)
vix_valid = is_valid(vix_raw)
all_valid = treasury_valid and vix_valid

# Get sequential valid values for Treasury yield using valuewhen
# occurrence=0 is most recent valid, occurrence=1 is second most recent, etc.
treasury_current = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(all_valid, treasury_10y)
treasury_lag1 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(all_valid, treasury_10y)
treasury_lag2 = valuewhen(occurrence=2)(all_valid, treasury_10y)
treasury_lag3 = valuewhen(occurrence=3)(all_valid, treasury_10y)

# Get sequential valid values for VIX
vix_current = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(all_valid, vix)
vix_lag1 = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(all_valid, vix)

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# Condition 1: Treasury yield rising 3 consecutive valid observations
# current > lag1 > lag2 > lag3 (4 points = 3 consecutive rises)
treasury_rising_3 = (treasury_current > treasury_lag1) and (treasury_lag1 > treasury_lag2) and (treasury_lag2 > treasury_lag3)

# Condition 2: VIX is rising (current > previous valid observation)
vix_rising = vix_current > vix_lag1

# Condition 3: VIX level above 18 (elevated volatility regime)
# Use forward-filled VIX for level check
vix_elevated = vix > 18

# Combined SHORT entry signal
# Only trigger on days when fresh macro data arrives (all_valid)
short_entry = all_valid and treasury_rising_3 and vix_rising and vix_elevated

# =============================================================================
# POSITION MANAGEMENT
# =============================================================================

# Zone executor with 2-bar hold (time-based exit if TP/SL don't trigger)
long_and_short_zone(hold_short=2)(short_entry=short_entry)

# Risk-based position sizing:
# - Risk 2% of portfolio per trade
# - Stop loss at 1% (stop_distance in percent)
# - Take profit at 0.5% (rr_ratio = 0.5% / 1% = 0.5)
risk_unit(
    stop_unit=StopUnit.percent,
    rr_ratio=0.5
)(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=1.0)
